authorship: Original test scenario, not sourced from any published Shadowrun adventure

state_model.time_handling: Time actions must eventually use verified SR3 or specifically labelled authored policy; none silently advances a fixed number of turns here.

verbs.blocking_issue: Concurrent System/Security Test, utility reductions and tally require complete engine validation.

outcome_policy.no_softlock: Multiple paths are intended; no claim of complete alternatives until their gated mechanics are executable.
outcome_policy.no_false_authority: Never infer a rule merely from hotspot labels, fictional scenario text or a source YAML path.
outcome_policy.failure: A failed rule test may set persistent flags or open a fallback branch, but the consequences must be specified and logged as authored narrative rather than fabricated SR3 mechanics.
